title: A Wind in the Door
author: Madeleine L'Engle
summary: Meg Murry's little brother Charles Wallace is seriously ill, with something wrong inside his cells. Meg is sent with friends on a strange journey to a microscopic world to try to save him.
readIf: you liked A Wrinkle in Time and enjoy gentle fantasy blended with big questions about love and good and evil.
skipIf: you want a stand-alone story or dislike science and spirituality woven into children's fantasy.
